scope: Actual owned native service crashes and auto-restarts with independent file-audio/actions data; actual socket timeout tests; no physical camera/audio faults, B0 or final endurance
verified: Actual LLM streaming, ASR native processing and TTS synthesis each interrupted by SIGKILL of the verified listener process; systemd automatically starts a new process
All four final scenarios emit failed result, enter release_unconfirmed while native recovery is pending, reject extra requests with 409, then return idle after native slot/concurrency checks
Failed turns publish no final WAV, leave no partial file and do not append session history; next native model turn produces downloadable PCM WAV
After note transaction commits, crashing LLM preserves the committed note/receipt; same request ID replays exactly that receipt without a second note or model tool round
Real slow-trickle socket reproduces the missing total call bound; new deadline aborts the owned connection and releases its local operation/timer
Six real socket adapter cases cover LLM/ASR/TTS with stalled headers and slow-trickle bodies, followed by a successful call on the same adapter
Previous deadline cannot interrupt a later real connection; cancellation remains cancellation when deadline and stop coincide
ASR/TTS clear prior error after a successful new operation
Test app exits cleanly, 8093 closes, seven existing services remain active, LLM/ASR native slots and OVS counters return idle
initial_failures: systemctl kill --kill-whom=all reported Invalid argument for auxiliary processes, although the main/native service exited and restarted. Preserve the failed harness run; later injection uses pidfd with listener/child/cgroup identity checks.
A first test app invocation used a nonexistent placeholder profile and failed before startup; the correct explicit profile was then used.
A final probe attempt connected before application startup completed; no fault was injected. The probe now waits for an explicitly ready state and records startup timeout as a preflight failure.
known_limits: Four scenarios passed twice: once before the deadline change, once with it; this is not the final ten-repetitions-per-fault acceptance
Timeout is one inference operation: LLM token counting/history trimming plus one generation, one ASR utterance, or one TTS chunk; not a whole multi-tool conversation or all speech chunks combined
Deadline interrupts the owned connected socket, joins its timer and reports failure; it cannot preempt GPU kernels, arbitrary Python work or a blocked native resolver
Startup/health-observation calls still use their HTTPX per-I/O timeouts; remaining liveness audit must cover these separately
Native backend capacity stays fenced until actually idle/recovered; expiration does not free GPU resources or count as successful release
Real hardware disappearance, camera epoch recovery, AEC/voice interruption, full application lifecycle repeats and 8h coexistence remain pending
Measured recovery durations are diagnostic samples and not performance B0 or a latency commitment
The inherited systemd launchers still depend on the legacy checkout; default runtime handover remains R4 work
verification_note: Final native run uses the deadline implementation and error-reset changes. Only documentation/unused-variable cleanup followed it; final source hashes identify the committed state. Test script formatting/readiness guard do not alter injected native workloads.
